# NOESIS repository instructions

Before drafting or changing an episode, read
`02_GUIDES/CHATGPT_DREHBUCH_BRIEF.md` and
`01_GLOBAL/00A_PRODUKTIONS_INDIVIDUALITAET.md` completely.

Every episode must be judged individually from the viewer's perspective for
retention, interaction, follower conversion, visual interest and feasible
quality. Historical word counts, act counts, shot counts, card counts, clip
counts, SFX counts and timing values are references, never universal creative
gates.

Keep facts, source identity, rights and technical delivery accurate. Do not
invent archive evidence or quotes. Reconstructions and subjective mystical
imagery may be creative when they are not presented as authentic records.

Canonical scripts belong in an episode's `01_SCRIPT/` directory. Do not place
new production files loose in the repository root and do not move established
pipeline directories without updating and testing their references.
